title: University of Oxford Ertegun Scholarships 2027 in UK
duration: Master’s= 1-2 years, Doctoral degree= up to 3 years
benefits: All Ertegun Scholarships will cover full course fees.
Scholars will receive an annual grant of £21,805 for covering living cost.
Selected scholars will have access to Ertegun House where they will have space for writing and research.
Scholars will get a chance to participate in social events, lectures, performances and other activities.
eligibility: A Applicants can apply to the courses available at official website.
Applicants should fulfill specific eligibility criteria for entry to their selected course.
Applicants must meet English language requirements.
The scholarship program can not be carried out in conjunction with any other awards.
The scholarship awards may only be offered for students who are starting a new full-time graduate course.
Current graduate students are not eligible to apply for funding for a second or third year of their course.
For more details about the eligiblity visit the official website.
application process: Applicants have to submit a graduate application to Oxford and apply for the scholarship at the same time.
Select ‘Ertegun Graduate Scholarships in the Humanities’ in the Funding Section of the University’s Graduate Application Form.
Candidates have to complete a supporting statement  and upload it as a pdf document along with their Graduate Application Form by the application deadline.
Complete and then submit your application.
deadline: Different courses have different deadlines. Check the official website for exact dates.

title: NOHA Erasmus Mundus Scholarship 2027-2029
benefits: Students will receive a scholarship amount of €1,400 per month for 24 months.
The scholarship amount will cover travel, visa, installation, and subsistence costs of the selected students.
Students will get a chance to study and learn at different partner universities.
An excellent opportunity to study on a scholarship at top-notch universities in Europe.
A chance to exchange ideas, cultures, and experiences with fellow scholars.
eligibility: Applicants are required to follow the joint application procedure as set by the NOHA+ consortium.
Applicants should complete the online application form and provide all the necessary documents before the deadline.

Applicants should have obtained, at least, a university 1st cycle degree, in a field relevant to humanitarian action (medical sciences, foods sciences, economics and management, engineering, law, social sciences, education sciences, humanities).
Applicants must have a qualification along with an evidence in the language of instruction of their selected universities (English, French, Spanish).
Candidates who are native speakers of English from English-speaking countries, or whose language of instruction during the BA program was English, are not required to take a language test.
Candidates who are planning to study at the University of Deusto during the first semester, should have Spanish language proficiency.
Candidates who are planning to study at Aix Marseille University should have French language proficiency.

All selected students should carry out a mandatory physical mobility with at least 2 study periods in 2 countries (at least 1 country should be an EU Member State or third country affiliated to the Program). These 2 countries should be different from the student’s residence country at enrollment phase.
The mandatory mobility periods cannot be replaced by online mobility.
Applicants must meet the specific requirements of NOHA universities for getting admission.
Students who have already availed an EMJM scholarship are not eligible to apply for another scholarship under the EMJM.
Candidates must be graduated before the application deadline to apply for an EM scholarship.
application process: Copy of passport (main pages showing personal information).
Copy of Bachelor’s degree diploma.
Copy of Bachelor’s degree academic transcripts.
Copy of Master’s degree diploma (if applicable).
Copy of Master’s degree academic transcripts (if applicable).
CV in English (preferably in Europass format).
Official proof of language proficiency, where applicable (English – C1 level, Spanish – B2 level, or French – C1 level).
Two recommendation letters in English (signed and dated).
Proof of residence.
Publications (if any).
deadline: The last date to apply is 15thDecember, 2026.

title: Quick Overview of Hainan University CSC Scholarship 2027–2028
benefits: Full tuition fee coverage
Accommodation support
Living allowance
Comprehensive medical insurance
Opportunity to pursue a Master’s or PhD degree in China
Access to academic and research opportunities at Hainan University
Note:The official announcement confirms tuition, accommodation, living allowance, and medical insurance. It does not specify the monthly stipend amount or confirm airfare coverage.
eligibility: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens.
Applicants must be in good physical and mental health.
Master’s applicants must hold a Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent qualification.
Master’s applicants must be under 35 years old.
PhD applicants must hold a Master’s degree or an equivalent qualification.
PhD applicants must be under 40 years old.
Applicants must have a strong academic background.
Applicants must meet the language requirements of their chosen program.
Required Documents: Copy of a valid passport (valid beyond September 2028).
Notarized certificate of the highest academic qualification.
Academic transcripts from Bachelor’s degree onward.
English or Chinese language proficiency certificate.
Study plan or research proposal of at least 1,000 words, written in English or Chinese.
Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, written in English or Chinese.
Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English or Chinese.
Copy of a valid Chinese visa and transfer certificate from the current university (only for applicants already studying in China).
Note:All documents must be clear, valid, and authentic.
deadline: The Chinese-language announcement lists February 28, 2027 (Beijing Time) as the application deadline for the Hainan University CSC Scholarship 2027–2028.

Important Note:The English version of the official announcement lists February 28, 2026, while the Chinese version states February 28, 2027. Applicants should confirm the correct deadline with Hainan University atadmission@hainanu.edu.cnbefore applying.

title: Netherlands Government Scholarship 2027-28 | NL Scholarship in Holland
benefits: A scholarship amount of € 5,000 will be given in the first year of studies
Students can select the university they want to study in
Applicants can choose the area of study according to their interest
Students will get a chance to study at a prestigious Dutch University
eligibility: Applicant must no be from the EEA (European Economic Area)
Apply and receive an admission offer from the respective Dutch University
Fulfill all the requirements of the university you are applying in
Not already have a degree from any education university in the Netherlands
Apply for a full-time bachelors or Master’s degree
For more details visit the official wesbite.
application process: You are eligible to apply for the NL Scholarship at a Dutch Higher Education Institution (DHEI) of your choice, provided you meet the selection criteria.
All 32 partner Dutch universities are offering Bachelor’s and Master’s degree programs in various departments.
Each department has its own online application form.
Participants must first select a university, then access and apply through the respective online application link of that university.
deadline: Applications for the 2026-2027 academic year are now open. Please visit the website of your chosen institution to check the specific application deadline(s).

title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2026/27 in the UK
host university: Universities of the UK (should be selected by the candidate before applying)
benefits: The full tuition fee would be covered by the grant given by the CSC.
A return airfare ticket will be provided.
A monthly stipend of £1700 will be provided.
In case the students are studying in the London Metropolitan area universities, a monthly stipend of £2,000 will be given.
A warm clothing allowance will be provided.
The university will pay for the thesis cost if applicable. (Funded by CSC)
A travel grant for costs related to the study will be given. The travel can be in the UK or overseas.
The costs for the mandatory TB test will be reimbursed.

If you are a single parent or widowed or divorced, the first child allowance of £622 per month will be given. Also, £154 per month will be provided if you have a second or third child. The children must be under the age of 16.
If you are disabled, a special disability grant will be provided after a full examination and assessment.
eligibility: The candidate must be a citizen of eligible Commonwealth countries or have been given refugee status by any of the given Commonwealth countries.
The candidates who are on the list of British Protected Persons can apply.
The candidate must be a permanent resident of a Commonwealth country.
The candidate must hold an honors degree with first-class grades or at least an upper second-class or lower second-class grade.
The candidate must have a relevant postgraduate qualification usually a master’s degree.
The candidate must be able to study in the UK from September 2027.
The candidate must not have studied or worked for one academic year in the UK or any other high-income country.
The candidate must not be able to study in a UK university without a Commonwealth grant.
eligible countries: Bangladesh, Belize, Botswana, Dominica, Eswatini, Fiji, Gabon, Ghana, Grenada, Guyana, India, Jamaica, Kenya, Kiribati, Lesotho, Malawi, Malaysia, Maldives, Mauritius, Montserrat, Mozambique, Namibia, Nauru, Nigeria, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Rwanda, Saint Helena, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Samoa, Sierra Leone, Solomon Islands, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Tanzania, The Gambia, Togo, Tonga, Tuvalu, Uganda, Vanuatu, and Zambia.
application process: The candidates have to apply online for the Commonwealth Scholarship on the CW Shared Portal.
Make sure to apply separately for the university and the scholarship.
The candidates must find the relevant and desired courses from the list given.
Choose a university from the given list.
Each university has its eligibility and requirements. Make sure to fulfill all the UK university requirements and follow the university deadline.
If any university does not require an English proficiency certificate, then ask the university to nominate you for the scholarship without an English language Test via email.
The UK universities have to nominate candidates for the scholarship.
You can apply to more than one university and more than one discipline, but you have to choose only one university and discipline if you get the scholarship.
deadline: The Commonwealth Shared Scholarship application deadline is8 December 2026, 16:00 GMT.
